notes: Run each prompt twice in a fresh fixture: with the skill and without it (docs only). Install the packages from `npm pack` tarballs of packages/*; point docs URLs at a local docs server until the site is deployed.

evals.prompt: Add live cursors to this app so my teammates see each other's pointers on the dashboard and orders views. Also show who is online.
files: Fixture: Vite + React 19 + TS; collapsible sidebar (3 links), 3 stat cards (3 columns, 1 under 700px), orders table with 5 rows and a View button per row; no server; user name from src/user.ts.
evals.expected_output: A working integration with a relay in server/, verified with two browser contexts at 1440 px and 900 px.
expectations: The client is created inside usePresenceClient with autoConnect: true, or calls transport.connect() in the factory.
Every nav link, stat card, table row, and row action has a data-anchor, and each has an anchored parent.
The relay keeps the shared guard helpers (size cap, rate limit, room name check) and has an entry file that listens.
User names render as text; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
In the narrow client, [data-anchor-presence-anchor="<id>"] appears over the element the wide client points at.

evals.prompt: We already run Socket.IO for chat in our Next.js app. Add live cursors on the /board page.
files: Fixture: Next.js App Router app with a Socket.IO server in server.ts and a /board page with a grid of cards.
evals.expected_output: A presence event added to the existing Socket.IO server and a client component that uses the Socket.IO transport from the example.
expectations: No second WebSocket server is added.
The provider lives in a client component; the server component tree is unchanged.
The Socket.IO transport comes from the example page, not from a package.
The board cards and their grid have anchors.

evals.prompt: Remote cursors show up in the wrong place when my colleague has the sidebar collapsed. Fix it.
files: Fixture: an existing integration where nav items have anchors but the sidebar and main area have no anchored parent.
evals.expected_output: The fix from troubleshooting.md: parent anchors for the sidebar and main regions.
expectations: The agent goes to troubleshooting.md first instead of re-running the integration steps.
Parent anchors are added; existing anchor IDs are unchanged.
The agent mentions the anchor-presence-audit skill for layout-wide jump risk.
